name: aladdin.colors
description: Canonical Aladdin color tokens for 'The Aperture'. Primitives are fixed hex; semantic tokens are theme-aware and reference primitives via {primitives.<name>}. This file is the source of truth; DESIGN.md frontmatter, frontend/src/styles/tokens.css, and the Tailwind theme mirror it.
maintenance: Manually maintained. On any color change, edit this file first, then propagate to DESIGN.md frontmatter and frontend/src/styles/tokens.css (see tokens/README.md).

basalt.description: Dark canvas / Admin default; warm-neutral graphite-black stone.

basalt-3.description: Highest dark surface step; secondary fills on dark.

limestone.description: BRAND stone. The Aperture mark, the auth Brand Panel, and the primary button label. No longer the light canvas.

plaster.description: BRAND stone. No longer the raised surface on light.

sand.description: BRAND stone. No longer the secondary fill on light.

quartz.description: Light canvas; the brand stone with the chroma removed (channel spread 4, vs 10 for Limestone). Warm, never cream.

quartz-sunk.description: Secondary fills, tags, chips on light.

quartz-hover.description: Pointer-over ground on light; one step short of quartz-sunk so a hovered row reads as armed and the current row still reads stronger.

quartz-line.description: Hairline border on Quartz. Luminance-matched to line-light within 0.0003, so it keeps that border weight while dropping two-thirds of the chroma.

quartz-line-strong.description: Strong border on Quartz. Luminance-matched to line-light-strong.

ink.description: Primary action fill on light; near-black.

lumen.description: Brand / AI point-of-light; glows and large fills.

lumen-deep.description: Supporting Lumen shade for larger marks on light.

lumen-ink.description: AA-safe Lumen tone for normal-size text/strokes/focus on light.

lumen-soft.description: Light Lumen tint for gradients and soft glow stops.

bronze.description: Trust/verification metal; seals and premium detailing.

bronze-deep.description: Bronze for larger marks on light surfaces.

bronze-ink.description: AA-safe Bronze tone for normal-size trust text and small seals.

lapis-bright.description: Lapis on the Basalt dark theme.

verdigris-deep.description: AA-safe success tone for normal-size text on light.

verdigris-bright.description: Success on the Basalt dark theme.

ochre-deep.description: AA-safe warning tone for normal-size text on light.

ochre-bright.description: Warning on the Basalt dark theme.

oxide.description: Danger (oxide red); AA on light and larger marks.

oxide-bright.description: Danger on the Basalt dark theme.

stone-muted.description: Quietest light text that still clears AA on the canvas/surface (not on the secondary fill).

line-light.description: BRAND hairline, retained as a primitive. Superseded as the light semantic border by quartz-line.

line-light-strong.description: BRAND strong hairline, retained as a primitive. Superseded by quartz-line-strong.

on-dark.description: Primary text on dark; also dark-theme primary action fill.

fg-muted.note: AA only on canvas/surface; NOT on the secondary fill quartz-sunk (4.47:1). See the Muted-On-Sunk Rule.

primary-foreground.note: Brand stone on ink. Unchanged by the Quartz move: neither token in this pair is the canvas.

accent-solid.note: Glows/fills/large marks only; not normal-size text on light.
